description: This file defines the ApplicationAutoScalingClient class, which is a client used to interact with the AWS Application Auto Scaling service. It includes method signatures for various API calls related to scaling policies, scheduled actions, scalable targets, and resource tagging, along with their asynchronous counterparts.

classes.name: ApplicationAutoScalingClient
classes.description: A client class used to interact with the AWS Application Auto Scaling service, extending the generic AwsClient.

methods.name: getPredictiveScalingForecast
methods.description: Retrieves forecast data for predictive scaling.

methods.name: getPredictiveScalingForecastAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves forecast data for predictive scaling.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously lists tags for a resource.

methods.name: putScalingPolicy
methods.description: Creates or updates a scaling policy.

methods.name: putScalingPolicyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a scaling policy.

methods.name: putScheduledAction
methods.description: Creates or updates a scheduled action.

methods.name: putScheduledActionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or updates a scheduled action.

methods.name: tagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously adds tags to a resource.

methods.name: untagResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously removes tags from a resource.
